text:
Mia: FYI customer @Acme is hitting a CI fail after switching to our Go v2 tagged release. Error in their CI: 'module declares its path as github.com/redwood/inference-go, but was required as github.com/redwood/inference-go/v2'.

Raj: Can you paste the customer's go.mod and repro steps?

Mia: Repro steps from customer: clone, `go build` in CI. Here's their go.mod snippet:

Mia: ```
module github.com/acme/service

require (
	github.com/redwood/inference-go v2.0.1
)
replace github.com/redwood/inference-go => ../local/inference
```

Mia: Locally the replace points at a checkout that still has `module github.com/redwood/inference-go` (no /v2). Their local dev works, but on CI the proxy uses the tagged v2 module and fails.

Olivia: Looks like a classic v2 import path mismatch. Once a module publishes v2 tags, upstream imports must use the /v2 module path or the module line in the replacement must match. Two quick fixes:
- Update the replace to include the /v2 path: `replace github.com/redwood/inference-go/v2 => ../local/inference` and ensure the local module declares `module github.com/redwood/inference-go/v2`.
- Or use `go get github.com/redwood/inference-go@v1.9.0` to pin to a v1 tag until you finish the migration.

Raj: I repro'd in a clean temp dir: `GO111MODULE=on go list -m all` fails with the same error when the replace points to a module whose module path doesn't include /v2. CI/proxy exposes the mismatch.

Mia: Customer says they only added the replace for local testing and forgot to update it before pushing the change that triggered CI.

Eng-oncall: Short-term: advise customer to either remove the replace or update it to point to the /v2 module path. Medium-term: we should add a troubleshooting note to our Go SDK upgrade guide explaining replace pitfalls with v2 tags. Also consider a small doc PR in the repo.

Olivia: We should NOT change published module path. Action: I'll open a PR to add a section under README: 'Upgrading to v2 — replace directive gotchas' with examples and CI tips. I can also prepare a v2.0.2 tag if we need to clarify docs in the repo and trigger a canonical build.

Support-bot: INC-4231 created and linked to customer email thread.

Mia: I'll reply to the customer with the workaround and the doc ETA (PR in next 2 business days). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
